LanguageData.Nemesis_Settings_ResolveHuntConfirm: End the hunt against {0} immediately? Use this before uninstalling Nemesis.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Stalker_0: {0}: "I counted the steps from the gate to {1}'s bed. Twice."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Stalker_1: {0}: "You never look up. I always do. Especially at {1}."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Stalker_2: {0}: "Shadows suit me. {1} looks better in them."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Butcher_0: {0}: "I don't write letters. I write wounds. {1} is next."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Butcher_1: {0}: "Soft people. Soft walls. {1} will break first."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Butcher_2: {0}: "Save the bandages. You will need them for {1}."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Saboteur_0: {0}: "Your grid hums like a heartbeat. I know where to cut it for {1}."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Saboteur_1: {0}: "Lights out. Locks open. {1} alone in the dark."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Saboteur_2: {0}: "I don't need an army. I need a fuse and {1}'s schedule."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Trickster_0: {0}: "Believe the next signal. Or don't. {1} loses either way."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Trickster_1: {0}: "I left a gift. Or a trap. Ask {1} which."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Trickster_2: {0}: "Truth is a tool. Lies are sharper. {1} will learn both."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_FoodStolen: {0} stole from your stores — {1} piles gone into their pack, not the dirt.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_CaravanStolenBody: {0} hit the caravan {1} and took what they wanted. Not ruined — taken.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_FireBody: Flames near the crops or wood. {0} left no signature but the heat — and a message for {1}.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Upgrade_Weapon: They left better armed — now carrying {0}.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Upgrade_Bionic: They left changed — a {0} where their {1} used to be.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_RivalCameoBody:
{0} appears on the edge of the fight against {1}.

"Nobody kills {2} but me."

They are not here for your walls.
LanguageData.Nemesis_CallingCard_Body: {0} ({2}) left this for {1}. The handwriting is careful. The threat is not.
LanguageData.Nemesis_CallingCard_LetterOnly: (The physical note could not be placed — the message still arrived.)
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_CallingCardBody: A marked scrap appears near the edge of the colony. {0} wants {1} to know they walked away alive.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_DeadAnimalBody: A small animal lies dead near the colony edge, a note pinned beside it. {0} is thinking about {1}.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_TrophyStolenBody: {0} took {1}. Not for money — for spite. Aimed at {2}.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Note_DefaultBody: The ink is smeared. Whoever wrote this wanted you afraid.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Journal_Body:
Journal of {0} ({2}).

Obsession: {1}.
Harassment events: {3}. Escapes: {4}. Days of hunt: {5}.

The last page is blank. They never finished the sentence.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_AnniversaryBody: {1} days since {0} started hunting {2}.\n\nThey remember. They always remember.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_SilenceBody:
Nothing from {0}. No raids. No taunts.

That is worse.

({2} — they are still thinking about {1}.)
LanguageData.Nemesis_Finale_AcceptDuel: Accept the duel — one on one
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_DuelBody: {0} stands alone for {1}. No backup. No escape left after this.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_FinaleAssaultBody: You refused the duel. {0} answered with everything they could buy, steal, or threaten — aimed at {1}.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Scar: {0}: "That mark on my {2}? Every time I touch it I think of {1}."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_MissingPart: {0}: "You took my {2}. I am going to take something from {1}."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Prosthetic: {0}: "This {2} is a reminder. {1} put it there. I put the next one."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Lover: {0}: "Tell {2} to keep {1} warm. I am coming for the one they love."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Bonded: {0}: "Cute little {2}. Does {1} know I have been watching them both?"
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Skill: {0}: "{1}'s {2} at level {3}. Impressive. Useless against me."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Bedroom: {0}: "I know which {2} is {1}'s. The door never looked that heavy."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Ignored: {0}: "Not even answering. Fine. I will make {1} listen."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_IgnoredBody:
You have not answered {0}. No arrests. No fight. Nothing.

The next message is shorter. The next strike will not be.

"{1} will hear me whether you want them to or not."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Low2: {0}: "I have your coordinates. All of them."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Low5: {0}: "This is personal now. {1} will learn that."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_High0: {0}: "You should have finished me when you had the chance."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_High1: {0}: "Every escape makes me more certain. {1} dies last."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_High3: {0}: "I've survived {2} times. What makes you think this time will be different?"
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_FavoriteFood: {0}: "I know what {1} likes to eat. {2}. Cute."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Taunt_Ion: {0}: "I like dry lightning. Your grid will too, {1}."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Intro_KilledAlly: {0} killed someone who mattered.\n\nA {1} named {2} has made it personal. They will not stop coming until {0} answers for it, or until they are taken alive.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Intro_Wounded: {0} left a wound that didn't heal.\n\n{1} of {2} survived, and they remember who did it. They are coming back.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Intro_Fixation: Someone from {0} killed one of yours — and for them, that wasn't enough.\n\n{1} has developed an unhealthy fixation on {2}. They're coming, and they're not interested in anyone else.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Intro_PawnDefault: Someone from {0} has decided that {1} is worth hunting.\n\n{2} will not stop until they have what they came for.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Intro_Prisoner: A prisoner slipped out, and someone noticed.\n\n{0} of {1} has taken it as an insult. Your colony will hear from them.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Intro_Slave: A slave rebellion made the wrong enemies.\n\n{0} of {1} has decided your colony owes a debt in blood.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Intro_Retaliation: {0} has had enough.\n\n{1} has been given authority to make your colony pay for it.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Intro_ColonyDefault: Something your colony did drew the wrong kind of attention.\n\n{0} of {1} has made your destruction a personal mission.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_CommsBody: Your comms console catches an unscheduled transmission.\n\n{0}
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_NoteBody: A note was left where your colonists would find it. No one saw who left it.\n\n{0}
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_RaidBody: {0} sent this raid. They want {1} to know who ordered it.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_AssaultPawn: {0} has come for {1} personally. They will pull back if things turn, but they will be back.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_AssaultColony: {0} is leading this assault in person. They won't stay if the odds turn against them.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_WasteBody: Chemical waste has been airdropped near your colony.\n\nA short message accompanied it: "{0} sends their regards."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Fake_Trader: a trade caravan requesting docking clearance
LanguageData.Nemesis_Fake_Distress: a distress beacon claiming survivors need extraction
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_FakeSignalBody:
Your console picks up what looks like {0}.

Something about the handshake feels wrong — but the channel is open.

(If this is {1}, it will not be a friendly visit.)
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_AmbushBody: The signal was a lie.\n\n{0} used it to walk a strike team onto your doorstep.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_CaravanWatchBody: {0} left a marker on the trade routes. Your caravans are being watched.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_CaravanHitBody: {0} hit {1} on the road. Supplies went missing in the chaos. A scrap of cloth was left with a name on it.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_SabotageBody: {0} pulsed EMP through your grid. {1} buildings took the hit.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_SabotageBlocked: {0} tried to fry your electronics — but EMP dampeners held the line. A frustrated hiss crackled on the open channel.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_SabotageSurgeBlocked: {0} hit {1} buildings with EMP. A surge protector ate the follow-up short circuit.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_SabotageBrain: {0} went for the brain — load shedders and grid monitors took the EMP first ({1} hits).
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_BeehiveBody: {0} kicked over {1} beehive(s). The bees are not amused. Neither should you be.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_WellFoulBody: {0} left something in the well.\n\nAnyone who drank nearby may already feel it. {1} was the joke.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_StrataBurrowBody:
{0} claims the tunnels.

"I paid the things under your floor to visit {1}."

Whether that is true or not, something is digging.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_FoodBody: {0} spoiled or stole from your food stores ({1} stacks damaged). Hunger is a weapon.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_FoodCellar: {0} found their way into your stores — including near the root cellar. {1} stacks were ruined.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_FoodFavoriteNote: {0} left a note for {1}: "No more {2} for you."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_AnomalyBody: {0} stirred something that should have stayed buried. Whatever is coming may not be entirely their doing — but they wanted you busy.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_KidnapBody: {0} sent a small team. They are not here to burn the place down — they want {1}. Alive, if they can manage it.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_SniperBody: {0} is on the horizon. The shots are not meant to kill — not yet. They want {1} to flinch.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_SniperFleeBody: The sniper is gone before anyone closes the gap. {0} left dust and a message in the dirt.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_GraveBody: {0} found your dead — and made sure you would notice ({1} sites damaged).\n\nMemory is a soft target.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_FoodTamperBody: Someone has been in the stores.\n\n{0} admits it now — one stack was treated. Anyone who ate from it may already know. {1} was the point.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_InformantBody:
A transmission from {0}:

"Those guests who just left? They talked. About doors. About watches. About {1}.

I pay well for honesty."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_RaidCreditBody:
{0} claims credit for the {1} raid.

"I sold them your layout. Cheap. {2} should thank me for the company."

Whether that is true or not, the guns are real.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_Escape1: {0} slipped away before you could finish it. They'll be back.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_Escape2: You had them. And then you didn't. {0} is still out there, and angrier for it.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_EscapeN: A figure in the smoke. Gone before the dust settled. Escape #{1} for {0}.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_EscapeMany: {0} has survived this {1} times now. They are not going to stop.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_CorneredBody: {0} has run out of escapes. They've gone down — and this time they cannot slip away.\n\nArrest them and take them alive to end the hunt for good.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_TruceBrokenBody: The truce with {0} has expired.\n\nThey never forgot. They were always coming back.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_RogueBodyFaction: You made peace with {1}. {0} did not.\n\nThey have abandoned their own people and thrown in with {2}. A treaty does not end a vendetta.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_RogueBodyAlone: You made peace with {1}. {0} did not.\n\nThey hunt you alone now. A treaty does not end a vendetta.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_EndedKilledBody: {0} is dead. The channel goes quiet.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_EndedTargetDiedBody: {1} is dead. {0} did not get to finish it.\n\nThere is no triumph in the channel — only a hollow quiet, like someone who arrived too late to a grave.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_GraveVisitBody: {0} stands near where {1} was laid.\n\nThey do not speak. They do not shoot. After a moment they are gone — and the hunt is finally over.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_EndedHandedBody: {1} is no longer yours. {0} considers the debt paid.\n\nThe taunts stop. The raids stop. They won.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Dialog_Body_KilledAlly: They came for vengeance. Now they sit in your prison.\n\nThree choices. None of them clean.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Dialog_Body_Prisoner: The one who made your colony their mission is behind bars.\n\nDecide what happens next.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Dialog_Body_Slave: The hunter who answered a slave rebellion sits in your cells.\n\nEnd it — or postpone it.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Dialog_Body_Fixation: The one who fixated on your colonist is captured.\n\nObsession does not survive a locked door. Usually.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Dialog_Body_Wounded: The one who refused to die is finally still.\n\nWhat you do next decides whether this story ends.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Dialog_Body_Default: {0} is captured. The hunt is over.\n\nWhat you do now shapes what comes after.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Dialog_Execute: Execute: End it permanently. They won't come back. Neither will the goodwill.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Dialog_Release: Release: Let them go. It costs you nothing now. Maybe more later.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Dialog_Keep: Keep Prisoner: They stay in your cells. The hunt is over. For now.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Dialog_Truce: Truce: Pause the hunt for {0} days. The game never truly stops.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Dialog_Recruit: Attempt recruitment: Resistance is broken. They might join — or spit in your face.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Dialog_Ransom: Ransom to their faction: {0} silver, a goodwill bump, and they walk home.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Dialog_HandToEnemies: Hand to {0}: {1} silver. Their enemies pay well. Permanent.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_ReleasedBody: You let them walk. {0} left without a word.\n\n{1}
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_KeptBody: {0} stays in your prison. The hunt is over. What you do with them is your business.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_TruceBody: You struck a temporary peace with {0}. They walk away, for now.\n\nIn {1} in-game days the hunt resumes. They never truly stop.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_RecruitedBody: {0} put down the vendetta — or buried it. Either way, they wear your colors now. The hunt ends.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_RecruitFailBody: {0} looked you in the eye and said no.\n\nThey stay a prisoner. The hunt is still over — the cell is not.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_RansomBody: {0} returns to {1} with a crate of silver ({2}). The channel goes quiet. Paid debts end hunts.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_BountyBody: You handed {0} to {1} for {2} silver.\n\nWhatever happens next is not your story. The hunt ends for good.
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_TruceGiftBody: A drop pod during the truce. Inside: {1}.\n\nA note from {0}: "Not a bribe. A reminder I am still thinking."
LanguageData.Nemesis_Letter_TruceWarnBody:
{0} cuts in over the raid channel:

"Not them. I get to do it.

Stay alive — this one is not mine."
